notes: The Balance Transfer Modeller can now move PART of a balance. Tick a debt and enter how much you'd move - useful when an offer has a limit lower than the balance, which is most of the time. Previously it was all of a card or none of it, so the most common case couldn't be modelled at all.
Whatever stays behind is spelled out, with the balance and rate it keeps, so you can see both halves of the decision.
